_doc: ROADMAP 7.1n2: mog S_4 (tables, strings, scripts) is C++-owned. tools/gen_data.py emits struct MogTables with the curated regions of tools/data_types.yaml typed (row structs from tools/tables.yaml), NUL-terminated text as writable char arrays ('strings') and everything else as byte-run members named after their asm labels. All mog_LAB_* names stay as .set aliases. Separate from mog.data.json (n1 twins) and mog.data_state.json (n3).
